name: Sticky Assistant
summary: A push-to-talk voice assistant with calendar, to-dos and weather pages, using Claude, Gemini or any OpenAI-compatible model.
description: Hold the AI button and ask: replies show on the e-paper screen, and the assistant can read and change your calendar and to-do list or search the web. Pages for calendar, to-dos and weather, plus plugins. Needs WiFi and the free sticky-assistant backend running on a computer at home (Docker or Python), which does the speech recognition and talks to your AI provider with your own API key, or a local model.

compatibility.notes: Tested on a reTerminal Sticky (ESP32-S3, 32MB flash used as 16MB). Needs 2.4GHz WiFi and the sticky-assistant backend on the same network; an AI provider API key (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) or a local OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama.

assets.previewAlt: Sticky Assistant's weather page on a reTerminal Sticky: current conditions, the next hours and a 7-day forecast.

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect the reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Erase on first install
notes.description: Use the erase option when replacing another firmware. Reinstalling without erasing keeps your WiFi and backend settings.

notes.title: After installing
notes.description: The screen shows how to join the StickyAssistant-Setup WiFi network and enter your WiFi and your backend's address. Start the backend first: see the project README.
